@@U01272@@
No, it’s much too soon for that.

@@U01274@@
If not a husband, a lover, then. To hold such a man in your arms is Heaven's greatest gift.

@@U01276@@
That’s not the custom around here.

@@U01278@@
Custom or not, it happens all the same.

@@U01280@@
Tell me more!

@@U01282@@
I stood beside his deathbed. Half-rotten straw, but at least better than a bed of manure. He also died Christian, knowing he deserved worse. “T hate myself, “ he cried, “from the depths of my soul! How could I forsake my trade like that, how forsake my wife? The thought of it is killing me. If only she'd forgive me in this life!”

@@U01284@@
(Weeping.)

@@U01285@@
Oh, the poor dear man! I forgave him long ago.

@@U01287@@
“And yet, God knows, she was more to blame than me!”

@@U01289@@
That’s a lie! The liar! To lie like that on the brink of the grave!
translation:
@@U01272@@
不，现在还为时过早。

@@U01274@@
如果不是丈夫，那就是情人。把这样的人拥在怀里，是上天赐予的最伟大的礼物。

@@U01276@@
这不是这里的习俗。

@@U01278@@
无论是否定制，它都会发生。

@@U01280@@
告诉我更多！

@@U01282@@
我站在他临终前的床边。半腐烂的稻草，但至少比一床粪肥好。他也是基督徒而死，因为他知道自己应该受到更糟糕的对待。 “我从灵魂深处痛恨自己，”他喊道，“我怎么能这样放弃我的职业，怎么能放弃我的妻子？一想到这些我就快要死了。要是她能原谅我这一生就好了！”

@@U01284@@
（哭泣。）

@@U01285@@
哦，可怜的亲爱的人！我早就原谅他了。

@@U01287@@
“然而，天知道，她的责任比我更大！”

@@U01289@@
那是谎言！骗子！就这样躺在坟墓的边缘！
